metadata.subtitle: CSS layout, drawn out — boxes, flexbox and grid in nine bite-sized lessons.
metadata.coverAlt: Hand-drawn coloured boxes arranged in a grid inside a circle
outcomes: Predict how boxes size and stack
Build rows and toolbars with flexbox

pages.title: Boxes all the way down

fields.objectives: See every box on the page; Tell block boxes from inline ones

pages.markdown:
Every element on a page is a box. Before you lay anything out, turn on an outline and **look** at the boxes:

```css title="debug.css"
* { outline: 1px solid hotpink; }
```

Block boxes stack down the page. Inline boxes flow along a line, like words. Most layout surprises are one of those two behaving exactly as designed.

:::quiz{data=""}:::

pages.title: The box model, drawn out

fields.objectives: Name the four layers of a box; Use border-box sizing

pages.title: The mystery of collapsing margins
pages.markdown:
Two vertical margins that touch become **one** margin, the larger of the two.

A heading with `margin-bottom: 32px` above a paragraph with `margin-top: 16px` has 32px between them, not 48px.

:::expandable{title="Why does it not happen in flexbox?" style="solution"}
Margins collapse only in normal flow, only vertically, and never inside a flex or grid container — which is one reason `gap` is so pleasant.
:::

pages.title: Grow, shrink and basis
When things wrap

fields.objectives: Wrap flex items; Know when to reach for grid

pages.markdown:
`flex-wrap: wrap` lets items fall onto a new line when there is no room. Each line is laid out on its own, so the last line can look lonely.

When you want items to line up in **both** directions, you want grid — which is the next module.

fields.objectives: Define grid tracks; Build a responsive gallery without media queries

pages.title: Named areas

fields.objectives: Lay out a page with named areas

pages.title: Pick the right tool
pages.markdown:
- **One direction, content decides the size?** Flexbox.
- **Two directions, the layout decides the size?** Grid.
- **Just stacking things with space between?** Either — with `gap`.

Take the final quiz to finish the course.
